name: Kajabi
tagline: All-in-one platform for courses, communities, email, funnels, and payments

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Basic listed at $179/month monthly and $143/month annually.

verdictSummary: You can build one course checkout or landing funnel, but Kajabi bundles site, course, community, email, automations, payments, analytics, and support.
coreLoopDIY: Build the specific funnel/course/membership needed with Stripe, a CMS, email provider, and gated content.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay to avoid stitching and maintaining a dozen creator-business tools.

priorArt.name: Moodle
priorArt.desc: Open-source LMS prior art; combine with email/commerce tools for partial Kajabi replacemen

notes: High price makes DIY attractive; all-in-one breadth makes full replacement hard.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Kajabi (All-in-one platform for courses, communities, email, funnels, and payments). Requirements:

- Core loop: Build the specific funnel/course/membership needed with Stripe, a CMS, email provider, and gated content.
- Needs: Stripe.
- Needs: email provider.
- Needs: CMS/course content.
- Needs: auth.
- Needs: hosting.
- Needs: analytics.
- Needs: automations.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: all-in-one stack; funnels; email automations.
